reviews_captured_by_me.text:
Daniel, the company president,  referred an unlicensed contractor to us for the plumbing and electrical work that was needed to complete the  counter-top/cabinet installation.
Though we had a  prior negative experience with the contractor he referred to us and felt he could not be trusted to complete the required work as promised at the price agreed upon, Daniel insisted that he could be trusted to do good work, and urged us to accept his recommendation by telling us the installation would be delayed 2 weeks if we didn’t allow his referral to do the work..  At the time, the original cabinets and counter-tops had already been removed.  We later discovered many leaks in the plumbing and were told by the plumber we usually hire that the under-sink plumbing was upside down, that all of the pipes were unsealed, and none of the plumbing was properly secured. As for the electrical work, we soon discovered that we are unable to use 2 appliances at the same time without tripping the circuit breaker.  To top it all off, Daniel’s referral installed used parts, including a switch plate of an unmatching color!

When we called Daniel to complain, he denied all responsibility, claiming we had hired his referral, and shouting: “Don’t call me again!”
